item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Drops El Clásico Jersey Ahead of Intimate Barcelona Concert For Top Spotify Fans: ‘I Cannot Wait to See Them’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where music meets sports. Today, we're excited to announce that singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo is teaming up with FC Barcelona and Spotify for a unique collaboration. Get ready, Rodrigo fans!"
[Sound effects: A quick soccer stadium ambiance]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo is heading to Spain to represent Barça with her own custom jersey, featuring her logo on the front. This special jersey will be worn by the team during their El Clásico match against Real Madrid on May 10th. But that's not all - fans can also get their hands on this limited-edition jersey, along with other exclusive merchandise, as part of the Olivia Rodrigo Collection."
[Sound effects: A quick music transition]
Host: "To celebrate this partnership, Rodrigo will be performing an intimate, one-off concert in Barcelona on May 8th. This invite-only show is exclusively for her top fans, who will be chosen based on their Spotify listening habits. The concert comes just a month before the release of her highly-anticipated third studio album, 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love', which drops on June 12th."
[Sound effects: A quick soccer crowd cheering]
Host: "Rodrigo is the youngest artist to team up with FC Barcelona and Spotify, following in the footsteps of Travis Scott, Coldplay, and Drake. She's clearly excited about the collaboration, saying, 'Getting to perform for the fans who've been listening since day one, in a city like Barcelona, is going to be so special.'"
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode. Don't forget to follow Olivia Rodrigo on Spotify and get ready for her new album, dropping soon!"
